info.title: Node echo service
info.description: The small echo service running on 127.0.0.1:8080 on every gateway node. agentgateway turns this description into MCP tools, so an MCP client can call a plain REST API with no MCP server in the path.

get.summary: Report which gateway node handled this call
get.description: Returns the echo service's view of the request, including the hostname of the node that served it. Useful for proving which of the three nodes a tool call landed on.

200.description: Request details as seen by the node

get.summary: Echo the request headers the node received
get.description: Returns the headers the upstream saw, after the gateway's header manipulation and transformation policies ran. This is how you confirm that x-verified-subject was set by the gateway from a verified token and not by the client.

get.summary: Return a chosen HTTP status code
get.description: Asks the upstream to respond with a specific status code. Used to exercise the retry policy.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: HTTP status code to return, for example 200 or 503.
